new_empty_presentation_failure.presentation: Six prerequisite errors and a reconnecting live viewer persist. Positive canonical-empty rule correctly does not classify canonical_empty=false as quiet; New created a saved empty Program bundle.
new_empty_presentation_failure.outcome: Distinct issue reported for explicit scope decision. No further New/Apply/retry or suppression was attempted. Private browser session closed to stop test noise; private runtime remains available.

limits: This receipt separates successful document handoffs from the failed final New empty presentation; it is not an unconditional end-to-end pass.

Initial private startup used an incorrect selected bootstrap argument against retained generic-bootstrap state and refused marker identity. Failed log retained; correcting only the owned launch argument reused the same runtime/cache and succeeded. No cold compile.

Initial browser timing observer used unbound Firefox fetch, causing read-only initialization/listing failures before any mutation. Binding original fetch to Window corrected test instrumentation; no product workaround.
No real robot, Isaac, Run, manual motion or graphics performance qualification. No optional additional empty New was executed.
